scope: SYNTHETIC ONLY; no real confirmed fraud, no deployment or production writes

design.legacy: Existing unchanged generator, 600 validation/1200 test, fresh seeds 10000+/20000+; labels are scenario fraud intent
design.stress: 9 explicit source-account scenarios, 50 validation/100 test each; labels are mule intent
design.stress_boundaries: Each scenario has half familiar 0-point candidates and half unfamiliar new-recipient 25-point candidates; own behavior is otherwise quiet
design.split: May validation and September test; separate synthetic identities; same generator in both
design.untrust: Recomputed from independent existing own-account rules, available before candidate; no labels or propagated score
design.history: Frozen baseline replay; only final candidate is changed in each method; no full-policy feedback simulation
design.links: Non-rejected historical attempts, including pending 2FA, as proxy; not confirmed settled Pix
design.time: Ordered event timestamps simulate trusted receipt clock; no out-of-order or delayed-label data
design.score_thresholds: Selected on validation per method for score ranking only, with 0/1/5 percent FPR budgets; frozen for test
design.limitations: Balanced/enriched synthetic mix; no real-world precision, calibration, money-loss or production latency claim
design.development_disclosure: Initial runs inspected during fixture debugging: intended 25-point candidates were below the minimum amount, and stale-contact amounts accidentally changed the payer profile. Corrected and regression-tested; not an untouched confirmatory holdout.
